clauses.fact: An ordered array of 1..100 equally long strings, each 1..1000 lowercase English letters, forms the grid rows.
Evaluate each column independently in original top-to-bottom row order.
Adjacent equal letters are allowed; a downward decrease makes that column unsorted.
Remove every unsorted column, rather than rearranging characters or permuting rows.
Return the integer count of removed columns.

derived_formalization.result: count of j for which some i in 0..n-2 has strs[i][j] > strs[i+1][j]
